key_patterns: ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by exploration): supabase/schema.sql contains ZERO GRANT statements. The campaigns table works through PostgREST because it inherited Supabase's platform default privileges (ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES grants ALL on tables to anon/authenticated/service_role for objects created by the dashboard/postgres role). The newer tables jobs/job_applications/banners were created by supabase/jobs_banners_LIKE_CAMPAIGNS.sql which does CREATE TABLE + ENABLE RLS + policies + NOTIFY but NO explicit GRANTs and NO sequence grants. PostgREST accesses tables as the anon/authenticated roles; without table-level GRANTs it cannot see them and returns PGRST205 'Could not find the table in the schema cache'. NOTIFY reload and project restart do not add missing grants, which is why the error survived both. The Flutter code is identical to campaigns (plain .from()), so this is purely a DB privilege/exposure issue.
